text:
marie: Dropped a new draft of the product launch post + benchmark appendix: https://docs.google.com/launch-draft. Need copy lock by Thu EOD so we can sync hero with design and lock webinar invite. Quick run? :eyes:

luis: reading now. Noted a few tone edits and one claim that might need numbers.

tanya: I can pull 90d latency and embed cost delta by model. Will add a small table in the appendix.

oliver: Heads up on headline direction 1: 'Serve LLMs at scale, predictably' vs 2: 'Run inference that costs less, performs better'. Want design to pick hero memo.

nora: For gated webinar routing: HubSpot form id 22456 for webinar; demo form id 33421. Which lists should go where?

marie: Mapping proposal:```
Hero CTA: Start free trial -> no form
Mid CTA: Book a demo -> HubSpot form 33421 -> list: Demo_Requests_Q1_2026
Footer CTA: Register webinar -> HubSpot form 22456 -> list: Webinar_Registrants_Launch
Follow-up: add tag 'source: launch_post' and property 'campaign: launch_apr_2026'
```

legal-bot: Automated check: flagged phrase in para 2: 'military-grade isolation'. Please remove or attach audit/SOC2 link.

luis: we should change to 'enterprise-grade controls' and link to https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2-report. That should clear legal-bot.

legal-bot: Re-scan request accepted. Will auto-clear when the link is present in doc.

tanya: Uploaded CSV with p50/p95 and sample sizes: https://drive.google.com/latency-q1.csv. Notes in the append: sampling only includes requests >=128 tokens.

oliver: Quick ask on benchmarks copy: call out p95 in the subhead 1 or we risk the 'predictable' claim being questioned.

marie: Agree. We'll add a parenthetical "(p95 across models shown)" under the subhead.

emily: If copy locks Thu EOD I can schedule publish Fri 11:00 PT. Also drafting webinar invite email now, will paste copy in the doc for review.

nora: I'll create HubSpot workflows tonight: route demo leads to SDR queue with 'priority: high' if company_size > 200. Webinar registrants go to nurture list.

marie: Action list: marie -> add SOC2 link and update phrasing (in progress), tanya -> confirm sample note (uploaded), luis -> final copy pass once SOC2 link in, nora -> workflows, emily -> webinar email copy. Please react :white_check_mark: when done.

legal-bot: Reminder scheduled: re-scan in 12h if unresolved.

luis: quick micro-edit: change subhead to 'predictable, cost-efficient inference' (shorter).

marie: applied Luis's tweak and inserted SOC2 link. Sending to final review. Thanks all 44D"
